context: A mom and son spend time at the pool
purpose: Teach: 水中/乾い/細く/硬い/吸い/触る/弾け/滑っ

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、水中で、息、止められる時間、長くなった!
lines.en: Mom—I held my breath underwater and it got so much longer!
lines.style: Bright, breathless excitement. Quick rush of words tumbling out. Seeking approval. Slight widening of eyes on the achievement.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: うん。洗濯物、乾いたら、畳んでね。
lines.en: That's wonderful. When the laundry dries, fold it for me, okay?
lines.style: Warm acknowledgment of his accomplishment, voice lifting on 「うん」. Then a gentle pivot to the request — matter-of-fact but not dismissive. The practical side settling in.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: パスタ、細くて、食べやすい。
lines.en: The pasta is so thin—it's really easy to eat.
lines.style: Small observation, slightly pleased with himself for noticing. Conversational, not performing. A child's genuine thinking-out-loud about something he's enjoying.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: お餅、硬いと、お母さん、食べづらいわ。
lines.en: Mochi's too hard when it's like that—makes it difficult for Mom to eat.
lines.style: Light, self-aware wryness. A small complaint dressed up as an observation, touching his chin. Gentle humor at her own age, not bitter. Slight smile underneath.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ジュース、ストローで吸いきっちゃった。
lines.en: I sucked all the juice out through the straw!
lines.style: Animated satisfaction. Emphasis on the completion—「吸いきっちゃった」. Pride in the accomplishment. Quick, energetic delivery. A small triumphant laugh underneath.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 熱い鍋、触るのは危ないからね。
lines.en: Hot pots are dangerous—don't touch them, okay?
lines.style: Firm but not sharp. The motherly tone that says 'I mean this.' Steady eye contact. A beat of pause before the warning, letting the seriousness land. Not scolding—protecting.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: シャボン玉、弾けたら、笑顔になる。
lines.en: Bubbles popping—it makes me smile every time.
lines.style: Soft observation, almost to himself. A moment of noticing his own joy. Quiet wonder mixed with contentment. Like catching yourself mid-happiness and naming it.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 石、滑って、転ばないでね。
lines.en: Be careful on the stones—don't slip and fall, okay?
lines.style: Warm, practical concern. Close and intimate, like the words come from someone who watches. No alarm, just the steady protection of someone who's thought about what could go wrong. A hand on his shoulder.
